parameters.name: ClusterId
parameters.description:
The ID of the hybrid cloud cluster.
>For hybrid cloud scenarios only, you can call the [DescribeHybridCloudClusters](~~2849376~~) operation to query the hybrid cloud clusters.

parameters.name: DetectionResult
parameters.description:
The evaluation result. Valid values:

*   **report**: Risks exist in cross-border data transfer.
*   **none**: No risks exist in cross-border data transfer.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description:
The end of the time range to query. The value is a UNIX timestamp displayed in UTC. Unit: seconds.

>  You can query only data of the previous month, previous 3 months, previous 6 months, previous 12 months, and data generated since January 1 of last year for compliance check. You must specify a valid time range.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the WAF instance.

>  You can call the [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) operation to query the ID of the WAF instance.

parameters.name: OrderKey
parameters.description:
The name of the sorting field. Valid values:

*   **total_count** (default): total number of data entries
*   **outbound_count**: total number of data entries that are transferred across borders

parameters.name: OrderWay
parameters.description:
The sorting method. Valid values:

*   **desc** (default): in descending order
*   **asc**: in ascending order

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Default value: **10**.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region in which the Web Application Firewall (WAF) instance is deployed. Valid values:

*   **cn-hangzhou**: Chinese mainland
*   **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland

parameters.name: ResourceManagerResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group.

parameters.name: SensitiveCode
parameters.description:
The type of the sensitive data. Separate multiple types with commas (,).

>  You can call the [DescribeApisecRules](~~2859155~~) operation to query the supported types of sensitive data. Only built-in types of sensitive data are supported for this operation.

parameters.name: SensitiveType
parameters.description:
The type of the information. Valid values:

*   **info** (default): full personal information
*   **sensitive**: sensitive personal information

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description:
The beginning of the time range to query. The value is a UNIX timestamp displayed in UTC. Unit: seconds.

>  You can query only data of the previous month, previous 3 months, previous 6 months, previous 12 months, and data generated since January 1 of last year for compliance check. You must specify a valid time range.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun waf-openapi describe-sensitive-outbound-statistic --instance-id waf-cn-0xldbqt0000 --start-time 1672502400 --end-time 1725966000 --sensitive-type info --sensitive-level high --sensitive-code 1000,1001 --detection-result report --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --order-key total_count --order-way desc --cluster-id 428 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-manager-resource-group-id rg-acfm000q --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun waf-openapi DescribeSensitiveOutboundStatistic --region cn-hangzhou --EndTime 1725966000 --SensitiveCode '1000,1001' --PageSize 10 --InstanceId 'waf-cn-0xldbqt0000' --ClusterId 428 --StartTime 1672502400 --DetectionResult report --OrderWay desc --ResourceManagerResourceGroupId 'rg-acfm000q' --SensitiveLevel high --PageNumber 1 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --OrderKey total_count --SensitiveType info
